RangeRead.title: RangeRead

SimilarRead.title: SimilarRead

TargetDetail.title: TargetDetail

    tamper: Tamper watch on or off, None for the profile default.
    faces: Face recognition on or off, None for the profile default.
    moving: Whether the lens moves.
    appearance: Whether people get appearance vectors for journeys across cameras.
    falls: Whether the view watches for falls.
    plates: Whether vehicle events read number plates.
    follow: Whether a moving lens follows a person.
    stream: Camera stream to analyse; the sub stream needs a camera with one.

Wall.title: Wall
Wall.description:
Straight wall segment between two points.

Attributes:
    x1: Horizontal position of the first end in meters.
    y1: Vertical position of the first end in meters.
    x2: Horizontal position of the second end in meters.
    y2: Vertical position of the second end in meters.
    material: Material of the wall.

WallMaterial.title: WallMaterial
WallMaterial.description: Materials a wall can be made of, which set how much it weakens the signal.

WebrtcAnswer.title: WebrtcAnswer
WebrtcAnswer.description:
go2rtc's answer to an offer.

Attributes:
    type: Always answer.
    sdp: SDP answer.
    stream: Stream that was opened.

WebrtcOffer.title: WebrtcOffer
WebrtcOffer.description:
An app's request to watch a camera over WebRTC.

Attributes:
    sdp: SDP offer of the app.
    stream: main or sub; sub falls back to main for a camera without a sub stream.

Window.title: Window
Window.description:
A weekly time window; an end not after the start runs past midnight.

Attributes:
    start: Start as HH:MM.
    end: End as HH:MM.
    days: Weekdays the window starts on, 0 is Monday; empty for every day.

ZoneFacet.title: ZoneFacet
ZoneFacet.description:
Zone to filter by.

Attributes:
    id: Id of the zone.
    name: Name of the zone.
    view: Id of the view the zone is drawn on.

ZoneInput.title: ZoneInput
ZoneInput.description:
A zone as the editor saves it.

Attributes:
    uuid: Id to keep, None for a new zone.
    name: Display name.
    polygon: Vertices in normalized view coordinates.
    whole_view: The zone covers the whole picture.
    labels: Labels and label groups the zone reacts to.
    min_dwell: Seconds inside before an intrusion opens.
    loiter_seconds: Seconds inside before a loitering event, 0 for off.
    crowd_count: Objects inside at once that make a crowd, 0 for off.
    schedule: When the zone produces events.
    alert: Alert policy.
    enabled: Whether the zone produces events.
    reference: Snapshot the zone was drawn on.
    left_seconds: Seconds a carried object stays still before it counts as left, 0 for off.
    taken_seconds: Seconds an object must have been present before its going counts as taken, 0 for off.
    object_labels: Labels watched for left and taken, empty for the default carried objects.
    background: Also find unclassed objects by comparing with the empty scene.
    animals: What dogs, cats and birds do in the zone.

ZoneRead.title: ZoneRead
ZoneRead.description:
A stored zone.

Attributes:
    uuid: Zone id.
    name: Display name.
    polygon: Vertices.
    whole_view: Covers the whole picture.
    labels: Labels and label groups.
    min_dwell: Seconds before an intrusion.
    loiter_seconds: Seconds before loitering, 0 for off.
    crowd_count: Crowd size, 0 for off.
    schedule: When the zone produces events.
    alert: Alert policy.
    enabled: Whether the zone produces events.
    reference: Snapshot the zone was drawn on.
    suspended: True while a moving lens no longer shows that scene.
    left_seconds: Seconds before a carried object counts as left, 0 for off.
    taken_seconds: Seconds of presence before a disappearance counts as taken, 0 for off.
